name: paymongo/module-magento2-paymongo
description: PayMongo payment gateway integration for Magento 2 — supports cards, GCash, GrabPay, Maya, GooglePay, ShopeePay, BillEase, BPI Online, UnionBank Online, QR Ph, and direct online banking. Luma compatible out of the box; Hyvä Checkout support ships separately as paymongo/module-magento2-paymongo-hyva.

suggest.paymongo/module-magento2-paymongo-hyva: Hyvä Checkout support (place-order redirect service, method icons, checkout layout) — registers itself only when hyva-themes/magento2-hyva-checkout is installed
